title: ר' אלעזר אביו של ר' יצחק בן אלעזר

paragraphs: Rabbi Elazar, father of Yitzchak ben Elazar, called Yitzchak Chakula or Yitzchak Nappacha, who testified to the snake on Elazar ben Perat’s cloak; see there. Our reading instead: Yitzchak ben Elazar testified about his upper room, etc. I found no claim that Chakula’s or Nappacha’s father was Elazar. Yuchasin follows his position—see Yitzchak ben Tavla—and is mistaken.
